summary: This is a listener class that responds to SampleEvent events. When the event fires, it automatically sets the first and last name properties on that event object using method chaining.

explanations.3: The namespace organizes this class into the App\Listeners folder structure, keeping listener classes grouped together in the codebase.
explanations.9: The handle method receives the SampleEvent object as a parameter and is the code that runs automatically when this event is triggered.
explanations.11: Method chaining allows multiple setters to be called in one line — setFirstName returns the event object so setLastName can be called on it immediately after.
